ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal straight line, and the order of the points from left to right is C, A, D, B; C to A represents the part obtained by extending BA to the left side of A, and D is located between A and B. Reasoning: It is known that AB = a, and AC = 1/2 AB = a/2. The whole segment BC = AC + AB = a/2 + a = 3a/2. D is the midpoint of BC, so BD = BC/2 = 3a/4. Since D is on AB, AD = AB - BD = a - 3a/4 = a/4. Also AD = 3 cm, therefore a/4 = 3, solving gives a = 12 cm.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a straight line with points ordered C, A, D, B from left to right, with C-A shown as the extension of BA and D lying between A and B. From the text, take AB = a, AC = (1/2)AB = a/2, D is the midpoint of BC, and AD = 3 cm. Compute the whole segment BC = AC + AB = a/2 + a = 3a/2. Since D is the midpoint of BC, BD = BC/2 = 3a/4. Because D lies on AB, AD = AB - BD = a - 3a/4 = a/4. Set a/4 = 3, giving a = 12 cm.
